title: Marconi believed the Magenta craft non-human

tellings.quote: Some documents on later family confirmations indicate Maronei genuinely believed the craft could be non-human.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, tells of a craft said to have been recovered in Italy in the 1930s, known as the Magenta craft. He says that some documents and later statements from his family indicate that Guglielmo Marconi, the Italian radio pioneer, truly believed the craft might not have been made by humans, which would put a famous scientist close to a very early UFO case.
